title: Paper Detour | 10 Grain Presets | Watchmaker Comparison | 2K Private Test
description:
Private technical comparison for user review. One user-supplied paper watchmaker still, ten grain settings, exactly four seconds per image plus brief numbered cards. Silent. Labels and full settings remain on screen throughout each image. No camera/parallax in this controlled comparison. 2560x1440, 30 fps, BT.709 SDR.

01 Balanced Base: luma RMS 3.0 codes, Gaussian sigma 0.77 output pixels, 30 Hz noise-field updates, rho 0.65.
02 Soft Amplitude: luma RMS 2.4 codes, Gaussian sigma 0.77 output pixels, 30 Hz noise-field updates, rho 0.65.
03 Upper Amplitude: luma RMS 4.0 codes, Gaussian sigma 0.77 output pixels, 30 Hz noise-field updates, rho 0.65.
04 Fine Grain: luma RMS 3.0 codes, Gaussian sigma 0.60 output pixels, 30 Hz noise-field updates, rho 0.65.
05 Coarse Grain: luma RMS 3.0 codes, Gaussian sigma 0.95 output pixels, 30 Hz noise-field updates, rho 0.65.
06 Slow Refresh 15: luma RMS 3.0 codes, Gaussian sigma 0.77 output pixels, 15 Hz noise-field updates, rho 0.65.
07 Slow Refresh 10: luma RMS 3.0 codes, Gaussian sigma 0.77 output pixels, 10 Hz noise-field updates, rho 0.65.
08 Short Persistence: luma RMS 3.0 codes, Gaussian sigma 0.77 output pixels, 30 Hz noise-field updates, rho 0.35.
09 Long Persistence: luma RMS 3.0 codes, Gaussian sigma 0.77 output pixels, 30 Hz noise-field updates, rho 0.85.
10 Test 03 Scaled: luma RMS 3.6 codes, Gaussian sigma 0.77 output pixels, 30 Hz noise-field updates, rho 0.65.

Monochrome grain with protected shadows/highlights. RMS means contrast, not opacity or amount. Sigma describes the Gaussian kernel, not measured grain diameter. Test 03 Scaled uses the earlier amplitude and spatially scaled size parameters on this new source; it is not identical prior footage. YouTube may reduce grain. No universal production preset selected yet. Compare at 1440p and 1080p.
